index.title: Automate Issue Triage and Music Playlist Creation
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Issue Triage. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Issue Triage and Music Playlist Creation. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A bot monitored public issues and PRs, and created playlists on Spotify based on drive distance and calendar events.
